verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਬੀਜ ਬੋਏ ਹੋਤ ਬਿਰਖ ਬਿਥਾਰ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਏਕੰਕਾਰ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise beej boe hot birakh bithaar gur pooran braham nira(n)kaar eka(n)kaar hai ||

en.bdb: As the seed sown develops into a tree and with time it expands, so has a True Guru emerged out of the one divine form of the all knowing, all powerful, Omnipotent God.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਏਕ ਬਿਰਖ ਸੈ ਹੋਤ ਹੈ ਅਨੇਕ ਫਲ ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਅਕਾਰ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise ek birakh sai hot hai anek fal taise gur sikh saadh sa(n)gat akaar hai ||

en.bdb: As a tree yields countless fruits, so is the gathering of many disciples (Gursikhs) of the True Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦਰਸ ਧਿਆਨ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਗਿਆਨ ਗੁਰ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਸਰਗੁਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬੀਚਾਰ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: dharas dhiaan gur sabadh giaan gur niragun saragun braham beechaar hai ||

en.bdb: Focusing mind on the holy form of True Guru who is the immanent manifestation of Lord, his percepts in the shape of word, its contemplation and understanding of the Transcendental form of God is in reality the contemplation of immanent Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸਥਾਨ ਸਾਵਧਾਨ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਗ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਉਧਾਰ ਹੈ ॥੫੫॥
verses.translit_en: giaan dhiaan braham sathaan saavadhaan saadh sa(n)gat prasa(n)g prem bhagat udhaar hai ||55||

en.bdb: By assembling in the holy congregation at the appointed place and meditating on Lord's name with total concentration and loving worship, can one sail through the worldly ocean. (55)
